description: The packages and add-ons for one of the signed-in customer's applications, as its answers make them apply: item ids and prices per step, what's already chosen, required steps without a choice, and the total so far. Items carry the firm's own sales wording: a badge on the option it recommends, a tagline, what's included (features) and fine print such as per-change fees.

application_id.description: The application's id (obs_…), from list_applications or start_application.
